title: Login block (brand panel + Card form loop, zod-validated)
description: Full-page login: brand side panel plus a centered Card running the complete form loop — `useForm` + `Form` + `FormItem` over `InputCore`/`PasswordInputCore`/`CheckboxCore`, validated by one zod schema through `standardSchemaFormValidator`.
author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs:
Full-page login: brand side panel plus a centered Card running the complete form loop — `useForm` + `Form` + `FormItem` over `InputCore`/`PasswordInputCore`/`CheckboxCore`, validated by one zod schema through `standardSchemaFormValidator`. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/login-block ``` The full-page source lands at `components/block/haze/login-block.tsx` (via the `@block/` target placeholder from `components.json`) — vendored, so you own and edit it. Component imports are rewritten to the `haze-ui` npm package, which is installed automatically together with `zod` and `react-use-control`. The file imports the stylesheet of every component it renders (`haze-ui/css/tokens.css` + 7 component css files), so no extra stylesheet setup is needed. ## Theming This wrapper re-exports the 'lightTheme' (or 'darkTheme'), 'spacing' and 'typography' classes from 'haze-ui' and imports 'haze-ui/css/tokens.css'. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Live preview and source: https://wmzy.github.io/haze-ui/#/blocks — https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
